property_summary: Calling Command with non-owner must revert OR, when called by the owner, it must not revert even if the callee reverts (i.e., owner-invoked Command never causes the transaction to revert).
change_summary: Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with a call that checks and reverts on failure (require(success)), changing behavior when the callee fails (previously ignored).
